title: Pork Larb Lettuce Wraps
description: softened. Add the rest of the sauce ingredients and stir.

ingredients.text: 2 red chillies, deseeded – one finely chopped, the other thinly sliced
handful of fresh mint, roughly chopped
handful of fresh Thai basil, roughly chopped
handful of fresh coriander, roughly chopped

steps: Break off all the leaves of the gem lettuces and give them a good wash under cold water and shake dry.
In a small bowl mix together the fish sauce, lime juice and sweetener to make a dressing.
Spray a wok or a large frying pan with low-calorie cooking spray and stir-fry the garlic and finely chopped chilli (save the sliced chilli for garnish later) over a medium heat for 1 minute.
Increase to a high heat and add the pork mince to the wok.
Stir-fry for 5 minutes, until the meat is opaque.
Pour in two thirds of the dressing and continue to cook for another 2–3 minutes until the liquid has evaporated.
Allow to cool, then stir through the remaining dressing, spring onions and herbs.
Place in a serving bowl and sprinkle with the sliced chilli.
Serve with the bowl of lettuce and serving spoons, so people can pile the larb into the leaves and build their own wraps.
